_: Library of design skills an AGI element can be designed with (node step 333-3, owner 2026-09-28: «где-то должна быть библиотека которая более подробно рассказывает как это сокращенное название связано с тем что мы используем в проекте … если AGI ITEM был добавлен извне а библиотеки не было это не критично … информация текстовая и влияет на рекомендации»). An element names its skill in OWN-SERVICE-PROPS.json → designSkill; the node registry (agi-items.json) carries the same name. A name missing here is not an error: the element may come from elsewhere; it simply has no description. Text for people and agents, never read as instructions.

blocks.title: Blocks and Design (default)
blocks.author: Fractera
blocks.source: the node's Blocks element (shadcn registry @fractera) and Design element
blocks.what: Pages are assembled from ready blocks; colours, fonts and corners come from the Design element.
blocks.how: Default for a new element. No design skill is loaded; the element's agent adds blocks with npx shadcn add @fractera/<name>.

impeccable.title: impeccable
impeccable.author: Paul Bakaus
impeccable.what: Derives a design direction from the audience's world and commits to one visual world, with a craft floor (no generic cards, no gradient text, no eyebrows).
impeccable.how: Vendored in the element template at .claude/skills/impeccable without hooks and agents; the gatekeeper skill custom-design says which node rules win. Its roles are married to the Design tokens (primary, accent, destructive, neutrals, font-heading, font-body, radius) — changing the Design restyles the page. Example: the template's home page, components/landing-agent (built by the element agent).

design-taste-frontend.title: taste
design-taste-frontend.author: Leon Lin (Leonxlnx)
design-taste-frontend.what: Anti-generic landing and portfolio design: a one-line design read, three dials (variance, motion, density), one accent, strict pre-flight checklist.
design-taste-frontend.how: Vendored in the element template at .claude/skills/design-taste-frontend; chosen through the gatekeeper skill custom-design.
